EmailTemplate.name: New Lead Follow Up 1: Scopes/Crit Num/Prop Data
EmailTemplate.subject: Memphis Invest: More info on our company and strategies.
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
{!Contact.FirstName},
I am so glad that we could connect today. As a follow up to our call, I wanted to provide you more in depth information about our company and our investment opportunities so that you can make an informed decision as to whether we are the right company to help you achieve your goals.
I have attached a document titled "Memphis Invest Critical Numbers", which gives a fantastic summary of our company data and metrics that we use to judge our own internal performance.
A second attachment called "Memphis Invest Property Data" gives realistic data on each market that speaks to average prices and rents. This also shows you the types of properties that you will be adding to your portfolio.
After you have had a chance to review this information please "click here" to set your next call with me so that we can continue to move you along in the process.
To your success,
